niche.title: The CIA Built a Spy Cat?! #historyfacts #animation #cartoon #funny #brainteaser #weirdhistory #quiz
niche.description:
The CIA really tried to turn a cat into a spy. 🐈‍⬛🎧

In the 1960s, the agency launched a secret project called Acoustic Kitty: a microphone in the cat's ear, a transmitter at the base of its skull and an antenna hidden in its fur. One tiny problem: cats don't follow orders. On its first field test, the cat reportedly walked into the street and was hit by a taxi almost immediately. Millions of dollars later, the project was quietly shut down in 1967.

Would you trust a cat with a top secret mission?

Sources: CIA memo "Views on Trained Cats" (1967, declassified 2001, National Security Archive)
